title: Order Shipment Flow
interaction_flow: ShipmentServlet → HttpSession: getAttribute('usertype') [access guard — redirect to login if null]
OrderServiceImpl → DB: UPDATE orders SET shipped=1 WHERE orderid=? AND prodid=? AND shipped=0
OrderServiceImpl → ShipmentServlet: return status ('Order Has been shipped successfully!!' | 'FAILURE')
UserServiceImpl → DB: SELECT fname FROM userdetails WHERE emailid=?
ShipmentServlet → MailMessage: orderShipped(userName, firstName, orderId, amount) [static call]
MailMessage → Admin/System: sends shipment notification email to customer
ShipmentServlet → Admin: render page + JS message overlay
key_relationships: ShipmentServlet depends_on OrderServiceImpl (instantiates directly: new OrderServiceImpl())
ShipmentServlet depends_on UserServiceImpl (instantiates directly: new UserServiceImpl())
OrderServiceImpl depends_on DBUtil (static calls: provideConnection, closeConnection)
MailMessage is a static utility class (no instantiation)

method_signatures.ShipmentServlet.doGet: protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws ServletException, IOException
method_signatures.OrderServiceImpl.shipNow: public String shipNow(String orderId, String prodId) — returns 'FAILURE' or success message
method_signatures.UserServiceImpl.getFName: public String getFName(String emailId) — SELECT fname FROM userdetails WHERE emailid=?
method_signatures.MailMessage.orderShipped: public static void orderShipped(String recipientEmail, String name, String transId, double transAmount)

db_operations.shipNow: UPDATE orders SET shipped=1 WHERE orderid=? AND prodid=? AND shipped=0
db_operations.getFName: SELECT fname FROM userdetails WHERE emailid=?

important_notes: Stock reduction (ProductServiceImpl.sellNProduct) does NOT occur during shipment — it occurs at payment time (paymentSuccess). The shipment flow only flips the 'shipped' flag from 0 to 1.
TransServiceImpl (TransService) is listed as a key element but is NOT invoked in the shipment flow — its getUserId() is only used in other flows.
ShipmentServlet annotation: @WebServlet('/ShipmentServlet'); handles both GET and POST (doPost calls doGet).
Access control: session attribute 'usertype' checked; null → redirect to login.jsp, no further processing.
Email is only sent on successful shipment (status != FAILURE); UserServiceImpl.getFName is called only in the success branch.
PageName alternates: 'shippedItems.jsp' (success) vs 'unshippedItems.jsp' (failure) — included via RequestDispatcher.include().
The shipped=0 guard in the SQL prevents double-shipping the same order line.
